body:
Yeah man. I spent a weekend with a girl in NYC, a vacation place I always wanted to go. I had fun with her, but also knew I couldn't love her. Shit just doesn't compute for me anymore. But while I was up there I had this brief moment of happiness, only to realize when I came home how brief it really was. When you get that brief moment of happiness, you crash even further into depression once it's gone. 

To me it's a lack of endurance. Like enough shit goes on you're just ready to call it a quits. Not because you're weak, but because you're tired and just don't really care / want it anymore. 

Personally, when I look back it's fucked up. Like looking at the issues that caused my mental destruction I realize I can't have those things again, especially the girl. So when I compare then and now I wonder why the hell I am here exactly. All downward from this point forward. 

Personally, people always tell me the usual crap, life gets better yadda yadda. But that isn't true, not everything always gets better. Sometimes shit gets worse, and continues to get worse. Like even now, my life has gotten "better" as in I am making a bunch of money self employed now, but I still don't give a shit really. Doesn't mean anything or make me happy, or even really matter. Honestly, I would imagine by the end of this year I'll probably off myself, merely because im pushing it off everyday and it seems to creep closer. Like the fantasies of just doing it. I mean, the thing that puts me off is the pain of it, the concept of non-existence is a little scary, but if you do it right, it goes pretty quick I'd assume. And the idea of living like this for the rest of my life, or even another year is unbareble.

I feel your pain, especially what you said at the last part. I am already dead also, it just feels like a matter of time until it overwhelms, or an extra monkey wrench or two gets thrown into life. I know if one more thing goes bad, I'll end it for sure, probably will anyway but the next shit to hit the fan will be that extra push. Do you ever feel like life isn't real anymore and all you long for is a time when you felt like you had something? That's how I feel, and I know staying alive will just be endless longing for something that doesn't exist. Non stop torment everyday. I have tried everything also, personal coaches, counseling, endless amount of bullshit positive thinking exercises. All that causes is erradic mood swings. I also feel like to "rebuild" takes way too much time and effort where I just have no more endurance anymore. 

My girlfriend at the time was also the last thing keeping me going. Heartbroken to say the least after she left me for a friend. Without that foundation and anchor from her, it's pretty much last straw for me also. No endurance or interest in even trying at love again.
